name: SwissAssociation
description: Document model for incorporating a Swiss Non-profit Association (Verein) under Art. 60-79 ZGB. Tracks the full 3-phase lifecycle: Pre-Incorporation, Founding Meeting, and Multisig Setup.

global.schema:
enum PrimaryLanguage {
  EN
  DE
}

enum MemberType {
  NATURAL_PERSON
  LEGAL_ENTITY
}

enum PhaseStatus {
  LOCKED
  IN_PROGRESS
  AWAITING_SIGNATURES
  COMPLETE
}

enum Stage2DocumentType {
  AOA
  FOUNDING_MINUTES
  MPA
  REG_GA
  DISSOLUTION_RESOLUTION
}

enum DissolutionResolutionForm {
  PHYSICAL
  VIRTUAL
  WRITTEN
}

type AssociationMember {
  id: OID!
  type: MemberType!
  name: String!
  nationalityOrCountry: String!
  residenceOrCity: String!
  representative: String
  ethereumAddress: EthereumAddress
  incorporationSignedAt: DateTime
}

type MultisigConfig {
  platform: String
  address: String
  keysTotal: Int
  decisionQuorum: Int
  privateChannel: String
  availabilityThreshold: String
  internalPolicyLink: String
  multisigDate: Date
  emergencyProcedures: String
}

type PhaseRecord {
  id: OID!
  phaseNumber: Int!
  name: String!
  status: PhaseStatus!
  documentsGenerated: Boolean!
  documentsSigned: Boolean!
  completedDate: Date
}

type GeneratedStage2Document {
  markdown: String
  isSigned: Boolean
  signedAt: DateTime
  isLocked: Boolean
}

type Dissolution {
  dissolutionDate: Date
  resolutionForm: DissolutionResolutionForm
  assetRecipient: String
  executingPersons: String
  remainingAssetsSummary: String
}

enum ContributorTermType {
  FIXED_DATE
  ON_SOW_COMPLETION
  NOTICE
}

type ContributorAgreement {
  id: OID!
  contractorIsEntity: Boolean!
  termType: ContributorTermType!
  contractorName: String
  contractorNationality: String
  contractorAddress: String
  entityName: String
  entityType: String
  entityJurisdiction: String
  role: String
  contractDate: Date
  workStartDate: Date
  workEndDate: Date
  terminationNoticePeriod: String
  sowNumber: String
  services: String
  fteHours: String
  compensation: String
  denominationType: String
  denominationCurrency: String
  generatedDocument: GeneratedStage2Document
}

type SwissAssociationState {
  nameEn: String
  nameDe: String
  seatCity: String
  seatCanton: String
  registeredAddress: String
  foundingDate: Date
  fiscalYearEnd: String
  membershipFee: String
  primaryLanguage: PrimaryLanguage
  purposeEn: String
  purposeDe: String
  members: [AssociationMember!]!
  boardMembers: [AssociationMember!]
  isPersonalunion: Boolean
  chairName: String
  chairRole: String
  secretaryName: String
  secretaryRole: String
  meetingIsOnline: Boolean
  meetingVenue: String
  counselName: String
  multisig: MultisigConfig
  stage2Started: Boolean
  aoaDocument: GeneratedStage2Document
  foundingMinutesDocument: GeneratedStage2Document
  mpaDocument: GeneratedStage2Document
  regGaDocument: GeneratedStage2Document
  dissolution: Dissolution
  dissolutionResolutionDocument: GeneratedStage2Document
  incorporationCompletedAt: DateTime
  currentPhase: Int
  phases: [PhaseRecord!]!
  languageClauseNeedsUpdate: Boolean
  belowRecommendedMemberCount: Boolean
  registeredAddressConfirmed: Boolean
  customNotes: [String!]!
  contributorAgreements: [ContributorAgreement!]!
}
global.initialValue: {"nameEn": null, "nameDe": null, "seatCity": "Zug", "seatCanton": "Canton Zug", "registeredAddress": null, "foundingDate": null, "fiscalYearEnd": "31 December", "membershipFee": "none", "primaryLanguage": "EN", "purposeEn": null, "purposeDe": null, "members": [], "boardMembers": null, "isPersonalunion": null, "chairName": null, "chairRole": null, "secretaryName": null, "secretaryRole": null, "meetingIsOnline": null, "meetingVenue": null, "counselName": null, "multisig": null, "stage2Started": null, "aoaDocument": null, "foundingMinutesDocument": null, "mpaDocument": null, "regGaDocument": null, "dissolution": null, "dissolutionResolutionDocument": null, "incorporationCompletedAt": null, "currentPhase": 1, "phases": [{"id": "phase-1", "phaseNumber": 1, "name": "Pre-Incorporation", "status": "IN_PROGRESS", "documentsGenerated": false, "documentsSigned": false, "completedDate": null}, {"id": "phase-2", "phaseNumber": 2, "name": "Founding Meeting", "status": "LOCKED", "documentsGenerated": false, "documentsSigned": false, "completedDate": null}, {"id": "phase-3", "phaseNumber": 3, "name": "Multisig Setup", "status": "LOCKED", "documentsGenerated": false, "documentsSigned": false, "completedDate": null}], "languageClauseNeedsUpdate": true, "belowRecommendedMemberCount": null, "registeredAddressConfirmed": null, "customNotes": [], "contributorAgreements": []}

if (action.input.nameDe) state.nameDe = action.input.nameDe;

modules.name: contributors
modules.description: Operations for managing the collection of contributor agreements (one per contributor)

operations.name: ADD_CONTRIBUTOR_AGREEMENT
operations.description: Adds a contributor agreement to the collection
operations.schema:
input AddContributorAgreementInput {
  id: OID!
  contractorIsEntity: Boolean!
  termType: ContributorTermType!
  contractorName: String
  contractorNationality: String
  contractorAddress: String
  entityName: String
  entityType: String
  entityJurisdiction: String
  role: String
  contractDate: Date
  workStartDate: Date
  workEndDate: Date
  terminationNoticePeriod: String
  sowNumber: String
  services: String
  fteHours: String
  compensation: String
  denominationType: String
  denominationCurrency: String
}
operations.template: Adds a contributor agreement to the collection
operations.reducer:
if (!state.contributorAgreements) state.contributorAgreements = [];
if (state.contributorAgreements.some((a) => a.id === action.input.id))
  throw new DuplicateContributorAgreementError(`Contributor agreement ${action.input.id} already exists`);
state.contributorAgreements.push({
  id: action.input.id,
  contractorIsEntity: action.input.contractorIsEntity,
  termType: action.input.termType,
  contractorName: action.input.contractorName || null,
  contractorNationality: action.input.contractorNationality || null,
  contractorAddress: action.input.contractorAddress || null,
  entityName: action.input.entityName || null,
  entityType: action.input.entityType || null,
  entityJurisdiction: action.input.entityJurisdiction || null,
  role: action.input.role || null,
  contractDate: action.input.contractDate || null,
  workStartDate: action.input.workStartDate || null,
  workEndDate: action.input.workEndDate || null,
  terminationNoticePeriod: action.input.terminationNoticePeriod || null,
  sowNumber: action.input.sowNumber || null,
  services: action.input.services || null,
  fteHours: action.input.fteHours || null,
  compensation: action.input.compensation || null,
  denominationType: action.input.denominationType || null,
  denominationCurrency: action.input.denominationCurrency || null,
  generatedDocument: null,
});
